name: Being Fit
overview: Scripture emphasizes that true strength and fitness go beyond physical capability, rooted in wisdom, knowledge, and reliance on Christ's power. Believers are called to present their bodies as living sacrifices, honoring God through disciplined stewardship of their physical selves. God provides strength to the weak and enables all things through Christ, underscoring that being fit is both a spiritual and physical endeavor empowered by divine grace.
